$comment: SP-01 SPIKE-ONLY permission allowlist for dev.wayvro.spike.sp01 (protocol §5.1, TC-21). Same shape as infra/ci/android/permission-allowlist.json, used with check-permissions.mjs --policy. It never applies to the one Wayvro app; the release allowlist is NOT widened for SP-01. `${applicationId}` is substituted by the checker.
phase: Phase 3 SP-01 disposable spike (candidate A: expo-location 57.0.20 + expo-task-manager 57.0.21)

allowed.name: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
allowed.justification: Precise location while online (go-online requires precise). Declared by expo-location's library manifest and plugin.

allowed.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
allowed.justification: Required alongside FINE on Android 12+ (approximate choice). Declared by expo-location's library manifest and plugin.

allowed.name: android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION
allowed.justification: SP-01 measures background tracking while online ("Allow all the time"). Added by the expo-location plugin (isAndroidBackgroundLocationEnabled).

allowed.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
allowed.justification: Location foreground service while online. Added by the expo-location plugin (isAndroidForegroundServiceEnabled).

allowed.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION
allowed.justification: FGS type location (Android 14+). Added by the expo-location plugin.

allowed.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
allowed.justification: Shows the FGS notification on Android 13+ (requested in the go-online flow; denial tolerated). Not used for push: the spike has no push library.

allowed.name: android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS
allowed.justification: STD-EXEMPT battery configuration (protocol §7): the standard exemption dialog, only on the founder's tap.

allowed.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
allowed.justification: Required by candidate A, not by a boot receiver: expo-task-manager 57.0.21 hands every location batch to a PERSISTED JobScheduler job (TaskManagerUtils.createJobInfo setPersisted(true)), and JobScheduler refuses persisted jobs without this permission (IllegalArgumentException, process crash on the first location callback; found in the 2026-10-16 emulator run). The spike still declares NO boot receiver: the BOOT_COMPLETED / MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED actions stay stripped from TaskBroadcastReceiver (plugins/spike-manifest.mjs) and check-spike-manifest.mjs still fails on them, so tracking never restarts by itself after a reboot (TC-09 measures what a persisted job does after boot).

allowed.name: ${applicationId}.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION
allowed.justification: Signature-level permission AndroidX core declares for non-exported dynamic receivers on API < 33. Grants nothing to other apps.

forbidden.name: android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT
forbidden.reason: M26/ADR-033 and protocol R8: offers never depend on full-screen intents; any SP-01 artefact containing it fails.

forbidden.name: android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
forbidden.reason: Motion activity is not part of SP-01 (isAndroidMotionActivityEnabled=false).

forbidden.name: com.google.android.gms.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
forbidden.reason: Motion activity is not part of SP-01.

forbidden.name: android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM
forbidden.reason: No alarms are used to wake the spike.

forbidden.name: android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM
forbidden.reason: No alarms are used to wake the spike.

forbidden.name: android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
forbidden.reason: Not declared by candidate A; if a dependency adds it, record and review before running.

forbidden.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC
forbidden.reason: Only FGS type location is allowed (TC-21).

forbidden.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_REMOTE_MESSAGING
forbidden.reason: Only FGS type location is allowed (TC-21).

forbidden.name: com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEIVE
forbidden.reason: No push (FCM) in SP-01 (protocol §5.1; TC-22 NOT RUN).
